summary: Milestone 2026.05.127 operational retrospective. Wall time 1070 minutes for 180 experiments (avg 6 min). Slowest path was Exp 1603 at 88 minutes, followed by an 82-minute doomed-rerun block on Exp 1663. Both GPUs were entirely idle at 0% utilization, meaning DualGPURunner was missed for parallelization. Estimated 40% time savings recoverable via fixing the doomed-rerun block and utilizing DualGPU parallelization.
